title: QMT135 — official race page
claims: The QMT135 starts in Baie-Saint-Paul from the Hôtel & Spa Le Germain Charlevoix and is listed at 134 km with +6,000 m of gain, −5,859 m of loss, 10 aid stations, technical level 5/5, an average finish time of 26:00:00 and a cut-off of 37:00:00.

The course follows the St. Lawrence on the La Baie, Gabrielle Roy Est, Louise-Gasnier and Gabrielle Roy Ouest trails to Mont à Liguori (Le Massif de Charlevoix), then almost entirely on the Sentier des Caps de Charlevoix to Saint-Tite-des-Caps, through the Dalle Humide, the Sainte-Anne river canyon and the Mestachibo trail to Jean-Larose falls, climbs Mont-Sainte-Anne almost twice and finishes on its south side.
The page lists course records of 16:40:30 by Kamil Lesniak (POL) and 18:12:06 by Valérie Arsenault (CAN), both set in 2026.
The page carries a '2026 Ranking — All finishers' label, its Register button points to runreg.com/qmt2026, and the page footer shows '223 remaining places'.
Entry requires a previous ultra trail race worth at least 75 points, calculated as 1 km = 1 point and 100 m of gain = 1 point; road and backyard ultras are not accepted.
The page badges the race as an ITRA 5-point race, an Athlétisme Québec sanctioned trail, and a qualifying race for a finish in 32:00:00 or less.

Mandatory gear is 1.5 L of water capacity, energy food, a waterproof windbreaker, a 1.4 × 2 m survival blanket, a cap or scarf, a headlamp, a spare headlamp battery, a mobile phone, a 3 × 48 inch self-adhesive compression bandage and an Epipen for runners with allergies.

One accredited crew member is allowed, at Le Massif, Saint-Tite-des-Caps, Mont-Sainte-Anne, Summit 1 & 2 and Auberge du Fondeur only; crew are not allowed at Halte de l'Arche, Cap du Salut, Cap Gribane or Mestachibo.
Pacers may run the last 32 km from either Mont-Sainte-Anne or Auberge du Fondeur, must be registered at bib pickup, pay CAD 10 in cash for a special bib, and one pacer per segment is allowed.
Three 20-litre drop bags are issued and collected at the start, going to Le Massif (#1), Saint-Tite-des-Caps (#2) and Mont-Sainte-Anne (#3).
Runners cross a stream under a culvert before the Saint-Tite-des-Caps aid station at KM 80 and one small stream at KM 125.
A free shuttle for runners only runs from the Mont-Sainte-Anne finish to the Baie-Saint-Paul start, takes about one hour and leaves from the Mont-Sainte-Anne main parking lot.
